title: Weapons Remastered
description: This mod adds new weapons like the battle axes, and Emerald sword, more coming soon!
body:
This mod includes **battle axes**, and an **Emerald sword!** I plan on adding more of your ideas you give!

Includes:

Battle Axe

Emerald Battle axe (better than battle axe)

Emerald sword (Better than diamond sword)

Flame sword (In the mix of Diamond and Netherite swords.)
